summary: Add per-PR reconcile contract tests on the fake runtime for what the restart, daemon-restart and concurrent boot canaries prove: a restart continues the recorded native session as a new incarnation, a predecessor still observed running after a daemon reopen is replaced exactly once, and five simultaneous starts get distinct incarnations without a crash-loop park.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no replay or stored data changes.

recovery.detail: No persisted runtime state or recovery change.
